name: check_members

test_list.description: Every package path in the crate table exists with a Cargo.toml and matches a member glob: no violations.
A directory matched by a member glob that has no Cargo.toml yields MissingManifest.
A regular file directly under apps/, crates/, crates/*/crates/ or tests/spike/ yields StrayFile.
A package listed in the table whose directory is absent yields NotOnDisk.
A matched member directory with a Cargo.toml that is not in the table yields NotInTable.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: Repository root containing the member globs.

output_description: All member violations (empty when consistent), or an I/O error while scanning.
